title: Clopen empty-fibre and constant fibre-rank loci
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a flat proper locally finitely presented morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and $E$ a finite locally free $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. Fix $r\in\mathbb N$. For $s\in S$, write $X_s=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ and $E_s=q_s^*E$ for tensor pullback along its first projection [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-residue-field, def-pc-module-pullback]. Both $\{s\mid X_s=\varnothing\}$ and $\{s\mid E_s\text{ is finite locally free of rank }r\}$ are open and closed in $S$; fixed rank means [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Empty fibres belong to the second set for every $r$.

proof.text: Define A_r as the set of points x admitting an open neighbourhood U on which E.restrict U has fixed rank r. Finite local frames (Modules.exists_mem_over_iso_free) give every point such a neighbourhood for some n. On intersections restrict both fixed-rank modules and apply finiteLocallyFreeOfRank_stalk_finrank at the common point to obtain r=n. Thus A_r is open by its definition, and every point outside A_r has a fixed-rank-n neighbourhood disjoint from A_r. Its complement B_r is therefore open too. No global rank function or finite set of ranks is needed.

For any g:Y→X, the canonical restriction-pullback isomorphism identifies (g*E)|g⁻¹U with (g|U)*(E|U). If g*E has rank r, choose a local rank n for E at g(y); the restriction has ranks r and n at y, so the stalk-finrank theorem gives r=n and g(y) lies in A_r. Conversely if all g(y) lie in A_r, the inverse images of their rank-r neighbourhoods cover Y; pullback preserves fixed rank and the local gluing theorem gives rank r globally. Identify tensorPullback with Modules.pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints of Modules.pushforward, using nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction. The empty Y case is included by the empty covering.

For q:X_s→X, Scheme.Pullback.range_fst and Scheme.range_fromSpecResidueField identify range q with f⁻¹{s}. The preceding criterion consequently identifies the fixed-rank fibre locus with S minus f(B_r). Scheme.isEmpty_pullback_iff and the same singleton-range formula identify the empty-fibre locus with S minus range f. These set equalities also handle mixed-rank and empty fibres without any connectedness or surjectivity assumption.

Mathlib UniversallyOpen.of_flat makes f open from flatness and local finite presentation. Properness makes f closed. Hence range f and f(B_r) are clopen, by applying the open-map and closed-map image properties to the clopen whole space and to B_r. Taking complements in the two set equalities proves both clauses.
